cost_formula_th_warehouse: landed_cost_thb = (cost_cny × exchange_rate) × (1 + import_duty_rate) × (1 + vat_rate) × (1 + warehousing_surcharge_rate) + local_handling_thb
allocation_rules: For each platform-SKU, allocate from the warehouse with LOWER landed cost first (optimal source).
Required stock per platform-SKU = ceil(daily_velocity × promo_days × safety_buffer).
If optimal warehouse has insufficient allocatable stock, supplement from the other warehouse.
Never allocate more than max_allocation_pct of any single warehouse's current stock for a single SKU across all platforms.
Minimum allocation per platform-SKU is 50 units; if required < 50, skip allocation for that combo.
The per-SKU cap (max_allocation_pct) is applied to each warehouse independently. Sum of all platform allocations from one warehouse for one SKU must not exceed warehouse_stock × max_allocation_pct.
